{
 "path": "programs/task-d8966d28.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The large object is the sole 8-colored shape; the small nonzero motif
    # gives one paint color for each equal-sized tile of that shape.
    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    marks = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    if not obj or not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in obj), max(r for r, c in obj)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)
    mr0, mr1 = min(r for r, c, v in marks), max(r for r, c, v in marks)
    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c, v in marks), max(c for r, c, v in marks)
    mh, mw = mr1 - mr0 + 1, mc1 - mc0 + 1
    sh, sw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    th, tw = max(1, sh // mh), max(1, sw // mw)
    tiles = {}
    for r, c in obj:
        key = ((r-r0)//th, (c-c0)//tw)
        tiles.setdefault(key, []).append((r,c))
    keys = sorted(tiles)
    colors = [v for r,c,v in marks]
    # Align the frequency-coded palette to the occupied tiles in scan order.
    if len(colors) >= len(keys):
        colors = colors[:len(keys)]
    else:
        # If tile dimensions differ, extend colors in their observed order.
        colors = (colors * ((len(keys)+len(colors)-1)//len(colors)))[:len(keys)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for key, color in zip(keys, colors):
        for r,c in tiles[key]:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
"
}

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    if not obj or not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in obj), max(r for r, c in obj)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)
    a0, a1 = min(r for r, c in marks), max(r for r, c in marks)
    b0, b1 = min(c for r, c in marks), max(c for r, c in marks)
    src = [[grid[a0+i][b0+j] for j in range(b1-b0+1)] for i in range(a1-a0+1)]
    # The little color diagram is rotated clockwise to color the large 8-shape.
    pat = [list(row) for row in zip(*src[::-1])]
    ph, pw = len(pat), len(pat[0])
    th = max(1, (r1-r0+1)//ph)
    tw = max(1, (c1-c0+1)//pw)
    seeds = [(i,j,pat[i][j]) for i in range(ph) for j in range(pw) if pat[i][j] not in (0,8)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in obj:
        i, j = min(ph-1,(r-r0)//th), min(pw-1,(c-c0)//tw)
        color = pat[i][j]
        if color == 0:
            color = min(seeds, key=lambda q: (abs(q[0]-i)+abs(q[1]-j), q[0], q[1]))[2]
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
"
}
